Checks: Separate editor services reuse the exact frozen canonical drawing
Frozen drawing is shared safely across STA threads
Exact source, including comments, partitions cache identity
Theme partitions cache identity even when prepared pixels coincide
Runtime identity conversion options partition cache identity
Dark prepared SVG never reuses a light drawing
Cancellation is honoured before a cache hit
Obsolete queued conversion cancels while conversion capacity is occupied
Repeated editor conversions retain bounded entry and character inventories
Eviction reconverts faithfully without changing canonical pixels
Active SVG is still rejected before conversion or cache lookup
Cancellation at converter entry lets the non-interruptible read complete and rejects its result
Cancelled non-interruptible conversion never enters the immutable cache
